5617 _render_offpage_setup_notice(data_view) 

5618 _fill_recovery_cache_panel() 

5619 return 

5620 

5621 # VIZ-14: local/desktop users can attach stimulus screenshots without 

5622 # adding an image_path column to their data. This intentionally stays out 

5623 # of public deployments and share links because it contains machine-local 

5624 # filesystem information; the same resolver is available through the API 

5625 # and CLI for reproducible headless renders. 

5626 if local_filesystem_enabled(): 

5627 with setup_stimulus_slot: 

5628 st.divider() 

5629 st.subheader("🖼️ Stimulus images") 

5630 image_root = st.text_input( 

5631 "Image folder", 

5632 key="stimulus_image_root", 

5633 placeholder="/path/to/stimulus-images", 

5634 help="Local folder containing one image per text or trial.", 

5635 ).strip() 

5636 image_pattern = st.text_input( 

5637 "Filename pattern", 

5638 key="stimulus_image_pattern", 

5639 value="{text_id}.png", 

5640 help="Use table fields such as {text_id}, {trial_id}, or " 

5641 "{participant_id}; subfolders are supported.", 

5642 ).strip() 

5643 if image_root: 

5644 try: 

5645 words_df = resolve_stimulus_image_paths( 

5646 words_df, image_root, image_pattern 

5647 ) 

5648 fixations_df = resolve_stimulus_image_paths( 

5649 fixations_df, image_root, image_pattern 

5650 ) 

5651 found = sum( 

5652 frame.get("image_path", pd.Series(dtype=object)) 

5653 .dropna() 

5654 .astype(str) 

5655 .map(os.path.isfile) 

5656 .sum() 

5657 for frame in (words_df, fixations_df) 

5658 ) 

5659 st.caption(f"Matched {int(found):,} table rows to local images.") 

5660 except ValueError as exc: 

5661 st.error(str(exc)) 

5662 

5663 # Optional raw gaze: the Upload source already mapped + normalized it above; 

5664 # every other source loads it here (bundled demo sample, OneStop uploader). 

5665 if raw_gaze_df is None: 

5666 raw_gaze_df = load_raw_gaze_data( 

5667 data_choice, host=data_location_slot, notices=menu.notices 

5668 ) 

5669 

5670 if preproc_settings["enabled"]: 

5671 fixations_df, preproc_report = preprocess_fixation_stage( 

5672 words_df, fixations_df, preproc_settings 

5673 ) 

5674 st.session_state["_preprocessing_report"] = preproc_report 

5675 st.session_state["_preprocessing_settings"] = dict(preproc_settings) 

5676 suspicious = ( 

5677 preproc_report[ 

5678 preproc_report["suspicious_word_load"].fillna(False).astype(bool) 

5679 ] 

5680 if "suspicious_word_load" in preproc_report 

5681 else preproc_report.iloc[0:0] 

5682 ) 

5683 if not suspicious.empty: 

5684 st.warning( 

5685 f"Data quality: {len(suspicious)} trial(s) put at least 12 " 

5686 "fixations on one word. Check stimulus alignment or line assignment." 

5687 ) 

5688 else: 

5689 st.session_state["_preprocessing_report"] = pd.DataFrame() 

5690 st.session_state["_preprocessing_settings"] = dict(preproc_settings) 

5691 

5692 # UX-7(b): if the selected corpus isn't on disk, say so here — in the main 

5693 # area, where the (demo) plot the user is actually looking at is — rather than 

5694 # leaving it to a sidebar line they've likely scrolled past. 

5695 _render_dataset_unavailable() 

5696 

5697 # Whole-dataset frames, captured BEFORE the sidebar "Filter trials" panel — 

5698 # the Bulk Export tab's "Export the whole dataset" option exports these, 

5699 # ignoring the current filters. 

5700 words_all, fixations_all = words_df, fixations_df 

5701 # DATA-20: every reader in the dataset, before any narrowing — what the 

5702 # participant-metadata join is reported against. 

5703 # 

5704 # Gated and cached, both deliberately. `participant_ids` is a `.unique()` 

5705 # over *both unfiltered corpus frames* — ~0.5 s on full OneStop — and on 

5706 # the default path (no table attached, not on the Data page) the answer is 

5707 # thrown away, so an unconditional call put half a second on every rail 

5708 # toggle and every ◀ ▶ step for nothing. The fingerprints are the ones 

5709 # computed just below for the identity report, so the cache key is free. 

5710 participants_all: list = [] 

5711 if data_view or metadata_mod.active() is not None: 

5712 participants_all = _cached_participant_ids( 

5713 words_all, 

5714 fixations_all, 

5715 cache_key=( 

5716 frame_fingerprint(words_all), 

5717 frame_fingerprint(fixations_all), 

5718 ), 

5719 ) 

5720 _refresh_participant_metadata(participants_all) 

5721 

5722 # UX-37: the dataset is loaded and normalized — one line saying *what*, and 

5723 # only when it changes. A rerun re-executes all of this, so an unconditional 

5724 # log here would print on every widget touch anywhere in the app. 

5725 log_state_change( 

5726 "dataset", 

5727 (str(data_choice), len(words_all), len(fixations_all)), 

5728 "Dataset ready", 

5729 source=data_choice, 

5730 words=len(words_all), 

5731 fixations=len(fixations_all), 

5732 ) 

5733 

5734 # VAL-7: does one `trial_id` actually cover several readings? A Trial ID 

5735 # mapping that under-specifies concatenates them, and the figure renders as 

5736 # an ordinary scanpath with a lot of regressions — nothing looks wrong. Run 

5737 # on the *unfiltered* frames: this is a property of the mapping, not of the 

5738 # current filter. The full evidence table is in 🔎 Data Inspection; here it 

5739 # gets one line, because the column name is the remedy. 

5740 identity_report = _cached_trial_identity_report( 

5741 words_all, 

5742 fixations_all, 

5743 cache_key=(frame_fingerprint(words_all), frame_fingerprint(fixations_all)), 

5744 ) 

5745 st.session_state["_trial_identity_report"] = identity_report 

5746 identity_warning = trial_identity_warning(identity_report) 

5747 if identity_warning: 

5748 menu.notices.warning( 

5749 f"{identity_warning} The evidence is on the 🗂️ **Data** page, " 

5750 "under **Trial identity**.", 

5751 icon="⚠️", 

5752 ) 

5753 

5754 # Trial-level filtering / grouping: narrow by participant, by condition 

5755 # (Hunting/Gathering, difficulty, first/repeated reading, correctness), and by 

5756 # annotation state (favorites / tags) before anything downstream sees the 

5757 # data. The controls now live in the Scanpath tab's Trial Selection panel 

5758 # (rendered there via render_trial_filters); here we just read the last 

5759 # selection from session_state so filtering stays global across every view. 

5760 trial_filters = read_trial_filters() 

5761 words_df, fixations_df = filter_trials( 

5762 words_df, 

5763 fixations_df, 

5764 participants=trial_filters["participants"], 

5765 metadata=trial_filters["metadata"], 

5766 ranges=trial_filters.get("ranges"), 

5767 ) 

5768 # DATA-29: a trial-grain metadata narrowing is already `(participant_id, 

5769 # trial_id)` keys, so it applies through `filter_to_keys` rather than 

5770 # `filter_trials` — the table is never broadcast onto the frames, which is 

5771 # DATA-20's rule and the reason this design holds at either grain. `None` 

5772 # means no constraint; an empty set legitimately narrows to nothing. 

5773 trialmeta_keys = trial_filters.get("trial_keys") 

5774 if trialmeta_keys is not None: 

5775 words_df, fixations_df = filter_to_keys(words_df, fixations_df, trialmeta_keys) 

5776 raw_gaze_df = filter_frame_to_keys(raw_gaze_df, trialmeta_keys) 

5777 # BUG-12: the raw-gaze samples table has to travel through the same 

5778 # annotation filter as words + fixations, or a sample row for an unstarred 

5779 # trial survives "⭐ Favorites only" — which also kept the all-three-empty 

5780 # guard below from ever firing, leaving the UX-7 guidance panel unreachable. 

5781 raw_gaze_scoped = raw_gaze_df 

5782 if ( 

5783 trial_filters["favorites_only"] 

5784 or trial_filters["required_tags"] 

5785 or trial_filters["excluded_tags"] 

5786 ) and not (fixations_df.empty and words_df.empty and raw_gaze_scoped.empty): 

5787 # Trials live in fixations normally; for words-only datasets the words 

5788 # frame carries them, and for raw-gaze-only ones the samples table — 

5789 # union all three so every frame's trials get judged by the filter. 

5790 present_keys = ( 

5791 trial_keys(words_df) 

5792 | trial_keys(fixations_df) 

5793 | trial_keys(raw_gaze_scoped) 

5794 ) 

5795 kept = set( 

5796 filter_keys( 

5797 list(present_keys), 

5798 favorites_only=trial_filters["favorites_only"], 

5799 required_tags=trial_filters["required_tags"], 

5800 excluded_tags=trial_filters["excluded_tags"], 

5801 ) 

5802 ) 

5803 words_df, fixations_df = filter_to_keys(words_df, fixations_df, kept) 

5804 raw_gaze_scoped = filter_frame_to_keys(raw_gaze_scoped, kept) 

5805 

5806 # Apply filters (participant/trial/text selection). For a raw-gaze-only 

5807 # dataset (no words/fixations) derive the participant/trial options from the 

5808 # raw gaze so it isn't filtered away (filter_raw_gaze drops on empty lists). 

5809 filters = default_filters( 

5810 words_df, fixations_df if not fixations_df.empty else raw_gaze_scoped 

5811 ) 

5812 words_filtered, fixations_filtered = filter_data(words_df, fixations_df, filters) 

5813 

5814 # Filter raw gaze data to match selected participants/trials 

5815 if not raw_gaze_scoped.empty: 

5816 raw_gaze_filtered = filter_raw_gaze( 

5817 raw_gaze_scoped, 

5818 filters.get("participants", []), 

5819 filters.get("trials", []), 

5820 ) 

5821 if raw_gaze_filtered.empty: 

5822 # Informational, not an error: the loaded raw-gaze samples just 

5823 # don't cover any trial in the current filter (raw gaze typically 

5824 # exists for only a subset of trials). The overlay is optional. 

5825 menu.notices.caption( 

5826 f"ℹ️ The loaded raw-gaze samples ({len(raw_gaze_df):,} rows) don't " 

5827 "overlap the current trial filter, so the raw-gaze overlay is " 

5828 "unavailable here." 

5829 ) 

5830 else: 

5831 raw_gaze_filtered = pd.DataFrame() 

5832 

5833 # Check for empty data after filtering. A single empty frame is fine 

5834 # (words-only / fixations-only / raw-gaze-only datasets); all empty means the 

5835 # filters removed everything. 

5836 if words_filtered.empty and fixations_filtered.empty and raw_gaze_filtered.empty: 

5837 _render_empty_after_filtering(words_all, fixations_all, trial_filters) 

5838 _fill_recovery_cache_panel() 

5839 return 

5840 

5841 # Build trial combinations for selection UI — from fixations normally, then 

5842 # words (words-only datasets), then raw gaze (raw-gaze-only datasets). 

5843 combos, _, _ = build_combo_options( 

5844 fixations_filtered 

5845 if not fixations_filtered.empty 

5846 else words_filtered 

5847 if not words_filtered.empty 

5848 else raw_gaze_filtered 

5849 ) 

5850 # DATA-20 §3 — the *one* place the participant table is joined onto anything. 

5851 # `combos` is one row per trial (tens to thousands), so this is the cheap 

5852 # projection the item asks for rather than a broadcast across every fixation 

5853 # — and it is enough: trial sorting, the trial labels and everything else 

5854 # downstream discovers its columns from this frame, with no allowlist to 

5855 # extend per surface. 

5856 combos = metadata_mod.project(metadata_mod.active(), combos) 

5857 # DATA-29 §3 — and the one place the *trial* table is joined, onto the same 

5858 # small frame. Everything downstream (the chip picker, trial sorting, Data 

5859 # Inspection, export) discovers its columns from `combos`, so this single 

5860 # left-join is what makes a trial field behave like a field in the data — 

5861 # again without broadcasting the table onto words or fixations. 

5862 combos = metadata_mod.project_trials(metadata_mod.active_trials(), combos) 

5863 

5864 # Land a shared/deep link on its exact `?trial_id=` (once) now that combos 

5865 # exist — see _apply_url_trial_selection. Runs before the sidebar/tab widgets 

5866 # render so the seeded selection is picked up as their initial value. 

5867 _apply_url_trial_selection(combos) 

5868 # Same hop, from inside the app: a "go to this trial" button in a Corpus 

5869 # Analysis table parks its request in a callback (before combos exist) and 

5870 # it is applied here — see url_state.request_trial (ENG-36). 

5871 _apply_pending_trial_selection(combos) 

5872 

5873 # Restore settings + annotations from an uploaded config JSON BEFORE the 

5874 # sidebar widgets render, so they pick up the saved values (see 

5875 # _apply_url_preset for the same preset-then-render mechanism). The uploader 

5876 # lives in the "💾 Save & restore" panel below; its file persists across reruns. 

5877 _apply_uploaded_plot_config(combos, fixations_filtered) 

5878 

5879 # Canvas and visualization controls (sidebar). For a raw-gaze-only dataset, 

5880 # size the canvas from the gaze extent and default the raw-gaze overlay on — 

5881 # it's the only layer there, so the plot would otherwise be blank. 

5882 raw_gaze_only = words_filtered.empty and fixations_filtered.empty 

5883 if raw_gaze_only and "global_show_raw_gaze" not in st.session_state: 

5884 st.session_state["global_show_raw_gaze"] = True 

5885 # VIZ-31: the monitor/font/background panel moved out of the sidebar into the 

5886 # Scanpath rail, so it is *resolved* here (no widgets) and *rendered* later, 

5887 # inside the rail, via the `canvas_renderer` below. Resolving first is what 

5888 # keeps the Corpus view — which has no rail — on the same canvas + typography. 

5889 canvas_geometry_frame = ( 

5890 fixations_filtered if not fixations_filtered.empty else raw_gaze_filtered 

5891 ) 

5892 ( 

5893 canvas_width, 

5894 canvas_height, 

5895 base_font_size, 

5896 font_family, 

5897 line_spacing, 

5898 scale_text_to_boxes, 

5899 ) = seed_canvas_state(words_filtered, canvas_geometry_frame, data_choice) 

5900 

5901 def canvas_renderer(slot, text_host=None, *, render_text: bool = True) -> None: 

5902 """Render the canvas/text controls into the rail, in two places. 

5903 

5904 UX-81 split the panel between two sections: the screen half into 

5905 ``slot`` (📐 Figure & canvas) and the typography half into ``text_host`` 

5906 (📄 Stimulus → Text). One call, so each widget is created exactly once. 

5907 """ 

5908 render_sidebar_canvas_controls( 

5909 words_filtered, 

5910 canvas_geometry_frame, 

5911 data_choice, 

5912 slot=slot, 

5913 bare=True, 

5914 text_host=text_host, 

5915 render_text=render_text, 

5916 ) 

5917 

5918 # The visualization controls moved out of the sidebar into the Scanpath 

5919 # screen's right-hand rail (tabs.render_single_trial_tab renders them via 

5920 # controls.sidebar_controls with host=rail). The other views — and the Save & 

5921 # restore panel below — still need the resolved settings, so read them from 

5922 # session_state without rendering any widgets; the rail's widgets are the 

5923 # source of truth and write the same keys. 

5924 viz_settings = viz_settings_from_state( 

5925 fixations_filtered, base_font_size, words=words_filtered 

5926 ) 

5927 

5928 # Whole-dataset combos for the Bulk Export tab's "Export the whole dataset" 

5929 # option, mirroring how `combos` is built from the filtered frames. 

5930 combos_all, _, _ = build_combo_options( 

5931 fixations_all 

5932 if not fixations_all.empty 

5933 else words_all 

5934 if not words_all.empty 

5935 else raw_gaze_df 

5936 ) 

5937 

5938 # Clear the "loading" bridges now that the real content is about to render 

5939 # in their place — the post-finalize one, and the view-switch one. 

5940 if _finalizing_bridge is not None: 

5941 _finalizing_bridge.empty() 

5942 if _view_bridge is not None: 

5943 _view_bridge.empty() 

5944 

5945 # Render tabbed interface. Animation is now a checkbox inside the Scanpath 

5946 # Visualization tab (no separate Animated Scanpath tab); Bulk Export has its 

5947 # own tab. Raw Data + Data Statistics are merged into Data Inspection. 

5948 # Dispatch the active view (sidebar nav). Only one view body renders per run 

5949 # — the keyed nav widget persists the selection across reruns, so no JS hack 

5950 # is needed (unlike st.tabs). render_single_trial_tab writes _share_selection 

5951 # and fills the Save & restore slot when it's the active view. 

5952 # UX-37: the three things a log reader wants to correlate a slow rerun with 

5953 # — which view, which trial, how narrow the pool is. One line each, only on 

5954 # change (see `log_state_change`). 

5955 log_state_change("view", active_view, "View", view=active_view) 

5956 log_state_change( 

5957 "filters", 

5958 (len(words_filtered), len(fixations_filtered), len(combos)), 

5959 "Filters applied", 

5960 trials=len(combos), 

5961 words=len(words_filtered), 

5962 fixations=len(fixations_filtered), 

5963 ) 

5964 

5965 if data_view: 

5966 # DATA-26 — fill the page reserved before the load. Everything above the 

5967 # dispatch already landed in its slot (source picker · description · 

5968 # options · data location · wizard · mode-A mapping panels); what is left 

5969 # needs the loaded frames, so it renders here. 

5970 # 

5971 # UX-54's dataset table is the first of those: its counts for the open 

5972 # dataset are this run's frames, which do not exist until the load has 

5973 # happened. Unfiltered on purpose — the table describes the *dataset*, 

5974 # not what the current Narrow-by left standing. 

5975 if not wizard_owns_page: 

5976 render_dataset_table( 

5977 host=dataset_table_slot, 

5978 # Public corpora load through the historical category token, 

5979 # while the table rows use concrete registry labels. Preserve 

5980 # that concrete canonical selection so the active row and its 

5981 # remembered counts are keyed to the row the user can revisit. 

5982 active=str(st.session_state.get("data_source_choice") or data_choice), 

5983 words=words_all, 

5984 fixations=fixations_all, 

5985 raw_gaze=raw_gaze_df, 

5986 ) 

5987 mapping_head_slot.divider() 

5988 mapping_head_slot.subheader("🔤 Column mapping") 

5989 mapping_head_slot.caption( 

5990 "How each source column maps onto the app's canonical fields — the " 

5991 "one thing that decides what every measure downstream is computed " 

5992 "from." 

5993 ) 

5994 with mapping_body_slot: 

5995 _render_column_mapping_section(editor_rendered=mapping_editor_rendered) 

5996 with setup_identity_slot: 

5997 st.divider() 

5998 st.subheader("🧾 Trial identity") 

5999 st.caption( 

6000 "Whether the Trial ID above actually identifies one reading — " 

6001 "checked on the whole dataset, before any filtering." 

6002 ) 

6003 render_trial_identity_section() 

6004 # ``setup_stimulus_slot`` is filled earlier because its values resolve 

6005 # image paths before filtering and plotting. Its reserved position puts 

6006 # it immediately before participant metadata on the Data page. 

6007 with setup_metadata_slot: 

6008 st.divider() 

6009 st.subheader("👤 Participant metadata") 

6010 # The *unfiltered* readers: the join report describes the dataset, 

6011 # not whatever the current Narrow-by left standing. 

6012 render_participant_metadata_section(participants_all) 

6013 st.divider() 

6014 st.subheader("🗂️ Trial metadata") 

6015 # DATA-29: same reasoning one grain down — the report describes the 

6016 # dataset's trials, so it is built from the *unfiltered* combos. 

6017 render_trial_metadata_section(combos_all) 

6018 with setup_body_slot: 

6019 st.divider() 

6020 dataset_label = str( 

6021 st.session_state.get("data_source_choice") or data_choice 

6022 ) 

6023 dataset_label = _dataset_display_name(dataset_label).replace("`", "'") 

6024 st.subheader(f"🔎 What's in the `{dataset_label}` dataset") 

6025 # Keyed wrapper → the stable `.st-key-…` selector the "Load and 

6026 # verify a dataset" tutorial spotlights (it kept its name across the 

6027 # move off the Scanpath subtab bar). 

6028 with st.container(key="tutorial_data_inspection"): 

6029 render_data_inspection_tab( 

6030 words_filtered, 

6031 fixations_filtered, 

6032 raw_gaze_filtered, 

6033 ) 

6034 elif active_view == _VIEW_CORPUS: 

6035 # UX-25: Corpus Analysis has no "Filter by" row, so the picker gets its 

6036 # own compact row at the top of the page — it stays reachable on every 

6037 # view without reopening the sidebar. 

6038 _ds_col, _ = st.columns([2, 5]) 

6039 render_data_source_picker(host=_ds_col) 

6040 with st.container(key="tutorial_corpus_analysis"): 

6041 render_corpus_analysis_tab( 

6042 words_filtered, 

6043 fixations_filtered, 

6044 canvas_width=canvas_width, 

6045 canvas_height=canvas_height, 

6046 base_font_size=base_font_size, 

6047 font_family=font_family, 

6048 viz_settings=viz_settings, 

6049 line_spacing=line_spacing, 

6050 scale_text_to_boxes=scale_text_to_boxes, 

6051 canvas_renderer=canvas_renderer, 

6052 ) 

6053 else: 

6054 # The Scanpath view renders the viz controls itself (right rail) and 

6055 # writes the global_* keys; re-read them below so Save & restore captures 

6056 # any edits the user just made in the rail. Data Inspection + Share are 

6057 # subtabs of this view now — passed in as renderers so the page owns its 

6058 # subtab bar (Data Inspection renders inline; Share builds the deep link). 

6059 render_single_trial_tab( 

6060 words_filtered, 

6061 fixations_filtered, 

6062 combos, 

6063 canvas_width=canvas_width, 

6064 canvas_height=canvas_height, 

6065 base_font_size=base_font_size, 

6066 font_family=font_family, 

6067 raw_gaze=raw_gaze_filtered, 

6068 line_spacing=line_spacing, 

6069 scale_text_to_boxes=scale_text_to_boxes, 

6070 combos_all=combos_all, 

6071 words_all=words_all, 

6072 fixations_all=fixations_all, 

6073 share_renderer=lambda: _render_share_body(data_choice), 

6074 data_source_renderer=render_data_source_picker, 

6075 canvas_renderer=canvas_renderer, 

6076 ) 

6077 

6078 # Re-resolve viz settings from session_state AFTER the dispatch so the Save & 

6079 # restore panel reflects any edits made in the Scanpath rail this run (the 

6080 # widgets there write the global_* keys during render). 

6081 viz_settings = viz_settings_from_state( 

6082 fixations_filtered, base_font_size, words=words_filtered 

6083 ) 

6084 

6085 # Save & restore (plot config + annotations) renders on EVERY view so it stays 

6086 # reachable when a non-Scanpath view is active (it's a sidebar panel). The 

6087 # trial selection comes from _share_selection (written by the Scanpath view; 

6088 # blank before any trial has been resolved this session). 

6089 _sr_sel = st.session_state.get("_share_selection") or {} 

6090 _sr_pid = str(_sr_sel.get("participant_id") or "") 

6091 _sr_trial = str(_sr_sel.get("trial_id") or "") 

6092 _sr_screen = _sr_sel.get("screen_id") 

6093 _sr_raw_gaze = ( 

6094 ( 

6095 extract_part(raw_gaze_filtered, _sr_pid, _sr_trial, _sr_screen) 

6096 if _sr_screen is not None and SCREEN_ID in raw_gaze_filtered.columns 

6097 else extract_trial(raw_gaze_filtered, _sr_pid, _sr_trial) 

6098 ) 

6099 if _sr_pid and _sr_trial and not raw_gaze_filtered.empty 

6100 else pd.DataFrame() 

6101 ) 

6102 _sr_figure_settings = _build_figure_settings(viz_settings, not _sr_raw_gaze.empty) 

6103 _sr_figure_settings["raw_gaze"] = _sr_raw_gaze if not _sr_raw_gaze.empty else None 

6104 _sr_figure_settings["line_spacing"] = line_spacing 

6105 _sr_figure_settings["scale_text_to_boxes"] = scale_text_to_boxes 

6106 

6107 def _render_session_backup_block(slot) -> None: 

6108 """The ⬇️ JSON backup block of the 💾 Session dialog (UX-100). 

6109 

6110 A closure, because the panel needs the live trial selection and figure 

6111 settings resolved just above — and the dialog is served a few lines 

6112 below, after `save_local_state`, so 🗄️ Automatic recovery can report the 

6113 write that just happened rather than the previous run's. This single 

6114 panel merges the former Plot-configuration and Annotations panels; it is 

6115 a session-wide feature, not part of any one source's setup. 

6116 """ 

6117 _render_save_restore_expander( 

6118 _sr_pid, 

6119 _sr_trial, 

6120 canvas_width, 

6121 canvas_height, 

6122 viz_settings["x_field"], 

6123 viz_settings["y_field"], 

6124 _sr_figure_settings, 

6125 viz_settings, 

6126 base_font_size, 

6127 _sr_raw_gaze, 

6128 font_family=font_family, 

6129 slot=slot, 

6130 ) 

6131 # A dialog body is a fragment: uploading a backup in here reruns the 

6132 # dialog, not `main`, and `_apply_uploaded_plot_config` runs in `main`. 

6133 # So a file the app has not applied yet asks for a whole-app rerun — 

6134 # which is also what closes the modal onto the restored figure. The 

6135 # applied-signature marker is the importer's own (it dedupes by 

6136 # `(name, size)`), so this cannot loop. 

6137 pending = st.session_state.get("plot_config_upload") 

6138 if pending is not None and st.session_state.get("_plot_config_last_import") != ( 

6139 pending.name, 

6140 pending.size, 

6141 ): 

6142 st.rerun(scope="app") 

6143 

6144 # Share now lives in the Scanpath view's "🔗 Share" subtab (rendered via the 

6145 # share_renderer passed into render_single_trial_tab), so it builds its deep 

6146 # link from the resolved trial + live viz settings right where it's shown. 

6147 

6148 # UX-65 — ❓ Help is a *menu* in the nav now, not a page of buttons: each 

6149 # entry arms the same dialog its button used to (menu._arm_help_action), and 

6150 # the dialogs themselves are untouched. Nothing to fill here anymore — only 

6151 # the tutorial chooser's context, which is data, not a widget, and has to be 

6152 # stashed on every run so the dialog can open over any view. 

6153 # 

6154 # 📚 Documentation left with the buttons: `st.Page` cannot be a URL, and the 

6155 # UX-62 wordmark beside the nav already opens the docs site. 

6156 stash_tutorial_context( 

6157 build_tutorial_context(words_filtered, fixations_filtered, combos) 

6158 ) 

6159 # UX-100: the 🐛 Debug toggle and panel moved inside the Session dialog with 

6160 # the rest of the group (`_session_dialog`), so there is nothing to fill here. 

6161 

6162 # Persist after all view/menu widgets have written their current values. 

6163 # The helper fingerprints the session and is a no-op on unchanged reruns. 

6164 save_local_state(st.session_state, app_url)
